tables.name: change_log
tables.comment: Automatic history of every change to catalog data: who, when, old and new values. Cannot be edited.
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX change_log_pkey ON audit.change_log USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX change_log_record_ix ON audit.change_log USING btree (table_name, pk, at DESC)
CREATE INDEX change_log_user_ix ON audit.change_log USING btree (app_user, at DESC)
CREATE INDEX change_log_at_ix ON audit.change_log USING btree (at DESC)

tables.name: v_layer
tables.comment: One row per layer with its active tileset, object count and stale flag. Used by the API and the inventory.

tables.name: dataset

columns.name: code
columns.comment: Short unique name (a-z, 0-9, _). It is the tag stored on every 3D object, so it cannot be changed once data is imported.

columns.name: crs_epsg
columns.comment: Coordinate system of the SOURCE files (record only). The database itself has one fixed coordinate system.

columns.name: vertical_datum
columns.comment: Height reference of the source: ellipsoid, egm2008, egm96, local or unknown. Needed to place tiles correctly in Cesium.

columns.name: attribution
columns.comment: Credit line shown on the map (copyright/source).

columns.name: bbox
columns.comment: Computed automatically from the data after import. Do not type by hand.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: active or archived. Archiving a dataset archives all its layers.

columns.name: created_by
columns.comment: Filled automatically with the signed-in user.

tables.comment: A collection of data for one area from one source, e.g. OIKN.
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dataset_pkey ON catalog.dataset USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dataset_code_key ON catalog.dataset USING btree (code)
CREATE INDEX dataset_bbox_gix ON catalog.dataset USING gist (bbox)

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER a_stamp BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON catalog.dataset FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog.stamp()
triggers.name: a_stamp

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER z_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON catalog.dataset FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change('id')
triggers.name: z_audit

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER b_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF code ON catalog.dataset FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog.dataset_guard()
triggers.name: b_guard

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER c_archive AFTER UPDATE OF status ON catalog.dataset FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog.dataset_archive_cascade()
triggers.name: c_archive

tables.name: import_job

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.comment: Fingerprint of the file, to prove which exact file was imported.

columns.name: lineage_tag
columns.comment: Tag written on imported objects: dataset.theme.lodN.

columns.name: validation_passed
columns.comment: True when geometry/count checks (e.g. val3dity) passed. Required before a layer can be validated.

columns.name: report
columns.comment: Detailed validation report (JSON).

tables.comment: One uploaded/imported file and what happened to it (the upload registry).
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX import_job_pkey ON catalog.import_job USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX import_job_dataset_ix ON catalog.import_job USING btree (dataset_id, started_at DESC)

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER a_stamp BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON catalog.import_job FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog.stamp()
triggers.name: a_stamp

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER z_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON catalog.import_job FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change('id')
triggers.name: z_audit

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER b_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON catalog.import_job FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog.import_job_guard()
triggers.name: b_guard

tables.name: import_job_layer
tables.comment: Which layers a file filled (one file can fill several).
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX import_job_layer_pkey ON catalog.import_job_layer USING btree (job_id, layer_id)

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER z_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON catalog.import_job_layer FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change('job_id', 'layer_id')
triggers.name: z_audit

constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES catalog.import_job(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.name: import_job_layer_job_id_fkey

tables.name: layer

columns.name: status
columns.comment: draft -> validated -> published -> archived. Moves are checked by the database.

columns.name: validated_by_job_id
columns.comment: The successful import that justified validation.

columns.name: bbox
columns.comment: Computed automatically after import.

tables.comment: What the frontend chooses: one theme at one LOD of a dataset (e.g. OIKN buildings LOD1).
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX layer_pkey ON catalog.layer USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX layer_dataset_id_theme_code_lod_key ON catalog.layer USING btree (dataset_id, theme_code, lod)
CREATE INDEX layer_lod_status_ix ON catalog.layer USING btree (lod, status)
CREATE INDEX layer_bbox_gix ON catalog.layer USING gist (bbox)

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER a_stamp BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON catalog.layer FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog.stamp()
triggers.name: a_stamp

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER z_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON catalog.layer FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change('id')
triggers.name: z_audit

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER b_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog.layer FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog.layer_guard()
triggers.name: b_guard

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER c_archive AFTER UPDATE OF status ON catalog.layer FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog.layer_archive_cascade()
triggers.name: c_archive

triggers.name: y_published_needs_tileset

tables.name: ref_generated_by
tables.comment: Who produced the data: an external provider, NARAGA, or manual work.

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER z_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON catalog.ref_generated_by FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change('code')

triggers.name: z_audit

tables.comment: Level of Detail per CityGML 2.0 (0 = footprint/terrain ... 4 = interior).

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER z_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON catalog.ref_lod_level FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change('lod')
triggers.name: z_audit

tables.name: ref_theme

columns.name: code
columns.comment: Short lowercase code, used in the lineage tag (dataset.theme.lodN). Do not change after use.

columns.name: citydb_objectclass_hint
columns.comment: Typical 3DCityDB class names for this theme (documentation only).

tables.comment: Subject of a layer: building, bridge, road, terrain ... Add a row to support a new theme.
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ref_theme_pkey ON catalog.ref_theme USING btree (code)

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER z_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON catalog.ref_theme FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change('code')
triggers.name: z_audit

tables.name: ref_tileset_status
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ref_tileset_status_pkey ON catalog.ref_tileset_status USING btree (code)

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER z_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON catalog.ref_tileset_status FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change('code')
triggers.name: z_audit

tables.name: tileset

columns.name: ion_asset_id
columns.comment: Cesium ion asset number (required when provider is cesium_ion).

columns.name: url
columns.comment: tileset.json address (required when provider is self_hosted).

columns.name: source_snapshot_at
columns.comment: Data state used for this build. If the data changed later, the layer shows as stale.

columns.name: height_offset_m
columns.comment: Vertical shift (metres) applied so buildings sit on the terrain.

columns.name: is_active
columns.comment: The one build currently served. Only a Ready tileset can be active.

tables.comment: One 3D Tiles build of a layer. Only the active one is served.
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tileset_pkey ON catalog.tileset USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tileset_layer_id_version_key ON catalog.tileset USING btree (layer_id, version)
CREATE INDEX tileset_one_active_per_layer ON catalog.tileset USING btree (layer_id) WHERE is_active

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER a_stamp BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON catalog.tileset FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog.stamp()
triggers.name: a_stamp

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER z_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON catalog.tileset FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change('id')
triggers.name: z_audit

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER b_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON catalog.tileset FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog.tileset_guard()
triggers.name: b_guard

triggers.def: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER y_published_needs_tileset AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON catalog.tileset DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog.check_published_has_tileset()
triggers.name: y_published_needs_tileset

constraints.def: CHECK ((((provider = 'cesium_ion'::text) AND (ion_asset_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((provider = 'self_hosted'::text) AND (url IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.name: tileset_provider_ck

constraints.def: EXCLUDE USING btree (layer_id WITH =) WHERE (is_active) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
constraints.name: tileset_one_active_per_layer

tables.comment: Number of 3D objects per dataset tag, class and LOD. Refreshed after each import.
